I saw a dream doing zina with my mother. im not married yet and have also been adopted by my parents. 12714 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, I am sorry this is very complicated. I do not know whether this is a dream or something else, but something very weird happened to me this morning. After Salat Al Fajr, I went to bed and started thinking about death and motherhood (I am not married)- I then just said the sleeping du'a and kalimah and closed my eyes. I don't know whether I was sleeping or not, but I had a "dream" where I remember having a flashback of being in the hospital with a baby, then there was a photocopier and all of the sudden I had to make 4 copies on A4, the copies came out on A3 and the copier was making a noise as if though it was damaged. When I tried to stop the copier, it was like I had gone into some kind of wajd, I couldn't touch the photocopier and my body felt a little paralysed- it was like I was underwater, but I was not, I was in this dreamy life; soon I started descending, almost floating and this was the weird thing- I was going down, floating down. Then I remember thinking that it maybe revelation, but then thought it must be death, so I whispered half the kalimah and all of the sudden my eyes opened- I was in my bed in the position I was floating down in; I then tried moving and Al hamdu lillah I moved and found that I was on my right side perfectly fine. I looked at the time and found that it was only 20 minutes after I had come to sleep. I was scared because I did not know whether I was asleep or not, or whether I was awake because I did not feel sleepy and Allahu 'alam. I have had the experience of sleep paralysis due to jinns, but this was different. I am very sorry for the detail. Jazak Allahu khair. 3626 views Q. Again we were talking then i saw the moon it was a full moon.then again i started to say about moon spliting into 2 i was really excited about this so i was telling him again see how much power allah has Hozoor sallalahu aliahi wa sallam just showed his finger and the moon split in 2 pieces see how Allah can do and while i was telling this i showed my finger to the moon and it split into 2 pieces again i told my brother lets see were this part of moon to my right side goes i saw it for a while than i was not able to see it becasue it had gone far and was looking very tiny then i was speaking with my brother from the right side a storm(twister) came wind was circling very fast and i realised it was coming towards us i told my brother it i coming here we did not run we stood there the wind came to us and me and my brother were in it i caught the pillar so that i dont get blown away and my brother was behind me then the wind took me and i heard some voice i could not here it i felt like some one is operating my heart i could feel pain in my chest the voice asked me something but i dont remember it and then i saw the moon it was full i was still trapped in the storm again a voice asked me are you ready i told yes and the storm stoped and turned into water vapours and all water fell on me and i was breathing heavily i was not able to brethe at all so i went to my house it was morning now and i entered my room and my sleep broke i got up and saw the time it was 3.40 in night still. after i got up i could feel some pain in my chest and heavy brething, i was not able to brethe when i got up i was pulling the air. please tell me about this dream and let me know what i should do i really get strange dreams. 1511 views Q. islamic beliefs 1665 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 52045 Country: Bangladesh Title: Dream interpretation Question: I am Golam Kibria from Dhaka, Bangladesh. Last night, I saw a dream that one of uncle/relative is coming to the airport, I could not able to recognize him, maybe he is my elder uncle, I saw one small girl with him, I thought that he is one of my cousins, but not sure. After some times, after receiving him I said him that it is time to prayer, so let us pray. Then I was making ablution/wudhu, during this time another person came and said to me to give place to make him wudhu from another tap. Answer ID: 52045 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 633/629/N=05/1435) One should take great care about salah and should not miss it. Also one should care for others betterment and comfort. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
